references.text: Jattir and Eshtemoa are mentioned as cities in the hill country of the tribe of Judah, which were later given to the Levites as priestly cities.
A parallel passage in Chronicles lists the same Levitical cities, including Jattir and Eshtemoa, which were given to the descendants of Aaron.
David sent part of the plunder to the elders in Jattir and Eshtemoa, showing that these cities were important Israelite settlements.
